newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-BRITISH LIONS BEAT MPUMALANGA 64-14 IN TOUR MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BRITISH LIONS BEAT MPUMALANGA 64-14 IN TOUR MATCH.

text.p: The British Lions beat Mpumalanga (formerly South Eastern Transvaal) 64-14 (halftime 35-7) in their rugby union tour match on Wednesday.
Mpumalanga - Tries: Piet Joubert (2). Conversions: Rynhard van As (2).
British Lions - Tries: Rob Wainwright (3), Matt Dawson, Tony Underwood (2), Neil Jenkins, Nick Beal, Ieuan Evans (2). Conversions: Neil Jenkins (7).
